title: A duality approach to the dense graph limit for biological transportation networks
summary: We develop a duality-based formulation of the dense graph limit for a variational model of biological transportation networks, where edge conductivities balance pumping power against metabolic cost. In contrast to the pressure-based approach of our previous work, which required conductivities to be uniformly positive, the present formulation allows general nonnegative conductivity kernels.
